review_text: Good experience with these guys for my balcony safety nets in Medavakkam! The installation was quick, efficient, and the nets are really unobtrusive. The quality seems great. Some wall drilling was needed, but they handled it professionally. While not a full 5 stars – they could've been a bit clearer on the building code compliance – I'm happy with the result. Hopefully, this lasts longer than my last net, which needed replacement way too soon. Overall, recommended!
